braid.convention: Closure is the link drawn. Generator +i is a positive crossing of strands i and i+1 (SnapPy/Spherogram braid_closure).

ribbonBraid.note: Blackboard ribbon: every strand doubled by an edge on one side, so a component's framing is the linking number of its core strand with its edge strand (equal to its writhe in the braid). Positions are 0-based.

seifert.note: Seifert's algorithm on the closed braid: one disk per strand, one twisted band per crossing. For a homogeneous braid this genus is the genus of the knot or link.
